name: South Town Crossing
demographics: South Town Crossing serves the growing Burleson, Texas market with a 3-mile radius population of 59,100 residents and an average household income of $107,800. The trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income families and working professionals seeking convenient shopping options in this southern Dallas-Fort Worth suburb. The center's fully leased status and strong anchor tenants appeal to value-conscious shoppers who prioritize quality national retailers and everyday convenience in a suburban setting.
description: South Town Crossing is a premier community shopping center located at 130 Northwest John Jones Drive in Burleson, Texas, serving the thriving southern Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. This fully leased retail destination encompasses 59,986 square feet of gross leasable area, offering residents and visitors a carefully curated mix of national retailers and service providers. Managed by Westwood Financial, a leading commercial real estate investment and management firm, South Town Crossing benefits from professional oversight and strategic positioning in one of Texas's fastest-growing suburban markets. The center serves a robust trade area with nearly 60,000 residents within a 3-mile radius and an impressive average household income exceeding $107,000, making it an attractive destination for quality retailers and shoppers alike. With its convenient location along Northwest John Jones Drive and strong tenant occupancy, South Town Crossing has established itself as a reliable shopping destination that meets the everyday needs of the Burleson community while contributing to the area's continued commercial growth and development.
summary: South Town Crossing is a fully leased 59,986 square foot community shopping center in Burleson, Texas, serving a prosperous trade area with nearly 60,000 residents and an average household income of $107,800.
